name: Trends – summary

columns.name: Year Quarter
columns.description: Helper: Year * 10 + Quarter; a formula counts its distinct values to tell a quarter-level group from a larger one

columns.name: Sales Amount
columns.description: Feeds Sales Amount (and Sales MTD per month)

columns.name: Sales PY
columns.description: Feeds Sales PY and Sales YoY %: sales of the same month one year earlier

columns.name: YTD at Month
columns.description: Feeds Sales YTD: running total within the year, per month

columns.name: YTD at Year End
columns.description: Feeds Sales YTD: the value on each year's last month

columns.name: YTD at Latest Month
columns.description: Feeds Sales YTD with no date axis: the value on the latest month

columns.name: QTD at Month
columns.description: Feeds Sales QTD: running total within the quarter, per month

columns.name: QTD at Quarter End
columns.description: Feeds Sales QTD: the value on each quarter's last month

columns.name: QTD at Latest Month
columns.description: Feeds Sales QTD with no date axis: the value on the latest month

columns.name: MTD at Latest Month
columns.description: Feeds Sales MTD with no date axis: the latest month's sales

columns.name: As Of YTD
columns.description: Feeds Sales YTD (As Of): sales from January 1 of the As Of year through the As Of date, constant on every row

Sales.Sales YoY %.ref: If(Coalesce(Sum({C:Sales PY}), 0) = 0, Null, (Sum({C:Sales Amount}) - Sum({C:Sales PY})) / Sum({C:Sales PY}))

Sales.Sales YTD.ref: If(CountDistinct({C:Month Start}) = 1, Sum({C:YTD at Month}), If(CountDistinct({C:Year}) = 1, Sum({C:YTD at Year End}), Sum({C:YTD at Latest Month})))

Sales.Sales QTD.ref: If(CountDistinct({C:Month Start}) = 1, Sum({C:QTD at Month}), If(CountDistinct({C:Year Quarter}) = 1, Sum({C:QTD at Quarter End}), Sum({C:QTD at Latest Month})))

Sales.Sales MTD.ref: If(CountDistinct({C:Month Start}) = 1, Sum({C:Sales Amount}), Sum({C:MTD at Latest Month}))

description: Reproduces Power BI measures: Sales Amount, Sales YTD, Sales QTD, Sales MTD, Sales PY, Sales YoY %, Sales YTD (As Of). One row per month (Month Start, Year, Quarter); each measure's formula reads the column that matches the visual's date grain.
